rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, proj_w=5, proj_kernel=5, bf_d_w_ratio=0.16666666666666666, manduca_N0=100000.0, manduca_bowtie=False, img_n_bf=6, img_kernel=9, img_sx=2.0, img_sy=2.0, img_sr=0.05, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-10 manduca_bilateral breast (train_n=400, val=200). SIX-BOX from BEST (iter-8 img_kernel=9 hr=0.2771): (1) PRIOR: best hr=0.2771 (iter-8). proj_n_bf 1->3 (iter-9) REGRESSED to 0.2472 (-0.030) -> proj-domain cascade over-smooths the sinogram (matches Mayo: proj-domain cosmetic); REVERT proj_n_bf to 1. Image spatial sigma (img_sx=img_sy=0.5px) UNTOUCHED. (2) FAILURE MODE: with img_kernel=9 the sigma=0.5px Gaussian spatial weight decays to ~0 within +/-2px, so most of the 9-tap kernel carries near-zero weight -- the extra taps from iter-8 are largely UNUSED; streaks spanning many px still aren't pooled. (3) ONE KNOB: img spatial sigma img_sx & img_sy 0.5 -> 2.0 (isotropic image spatial bandwidth, one conceptual knob; proj_n_bf reverted to 1, img_kernel=9 kept). (4) HYPOTHESIS: img_sx/sy 0.5->2.0 lifts hr above 0.2771 because the wider spatial sigma makes the 9-tap kernel's outer taps carry real weight, extending effective spatial reach to pool coherent streak pixels (still range-gated at sigma_r=0.05 so edges preserved). FALSIFIER: if hr drops, spatial pooling over-blurs -> optimum sigma_spatial near 1.0 -> iter-11 bisects. (5) BUDGET: same params/cost as iter-8 ~500s, under 20-min. (6) Loop continues; iter-11 on landing. turbo, save ckpt+recon, params_M logged.
